name: Value DeFi MultiStables vault share value from manipulable Curve 3pool quote
summary: MultiStablesVault priced shares with the controller's balanceOf, which converts the BUSD- and sUSD-pool strategy holdings to 3CRV through ShareConverter.convert_shares_rate using Curve 3pool's spot calc_token_amount. In one transaction the attacker deposited DAI, imbalanced the 3pool to inflate those holdings' 3CRV value, and redeemed its shares for more 3CRV than it put in.
notes: Reset: governance's setCap(0) removed the 10M deposit cap while the vault's balance (10.75M 3CRV) already exceeded it, so depositFor would have reverted '>totalDepositCap' and the exploit's deposit needed this change. The cap was set to 1 right after the exploit.

Loss is the 3CRV that left the vault and its 3pool strategy gauge 0xbfcf6329, net of the attacker's same-transaction deposit. The 2M DAI the attacker sent to the deployer in the same transaction is a recovery and is not subtracted; Value DeFi's ~6M USD figure nets it.
